title: Partition proof gaps: finite weighted cancellation and certificate audit
objective: Complete the first bounded increment of the gap-closure plan: freeze the actual theorem statements, attempt a pinned external-certificate build and semantic inventory within declared resource limits, and prove degreewise survivor cancellation for complete finite height-two tableau families, or identify the precise unresolved obligation without claiming completion.
deliverables: Pinned source, toolchain, actual theorem signatures, and dependency manifest
External certificate build-feasibility and semantic-statement report, with exact commands, resource use, and blockers
Complete finite actual-tableau families, fixed-shape bubble map, and degreewise image/complement count identity, or the exact remaining formal obligation
Separate critic's verdict tied to declarations and assumptions, followed by at most two bounded proposal/review rounds
Hash-bound verification evidence and an updated gap ledger distinguishing this increment from the full coloring-to-elementary theorem
success_criteria: All source versions and actual definitions are pinned before proof changes
The count identity concerns complete actual-tableau families and follows from a proved weight-preserving injection; truncated subtraction cannot mask negativity
The external audit reports build assurance and mathematical meaning separately, with no placeholder or unrecorded trusted assumption accepted as a proof
The final formal statements build and pass a distinct role's semantic review; missing obligations are explicitly incomplete
The full height-two coloring identity and the general theorem remain open in our ledger unless their separate acceptance gates are actually met
stop_conditions: Two proposal/review rounds are exhausted for this increment; preserve failed obligations and scope the next increment
The external build audit reaches 60 cumulative build-process minutes or 15 GiB of dependency/build storage, or lacks required disk space
At most one clean build attempt and one diagnosed retry are allowed within the external-audit limits
A theorem needs an additional hypothesis or semantic equivalence that has not been proved; mark it conditional or incomplete
No automated paid provider calls or deployment/publication beyond the user-authorized repository work
